method: Manual reading of shared dispatch/transaction and listed handler method bodies; declarative recipes read in full; route ledger then asserts 145 recipes/142 IDs and resolves every listed method locator.
limits: No game execution or commercial-media boot performed.
Body reviews delegated in rows explicitly marked accordingly.
Native helper caller review alone is not source/binary parity proof.
No claim of upstream completeness is inferred from successful build, imported assets, executable format or output hashes.

generic.behavior: Unpack official package, execute declarative input/copy/mkdir contract, verify required files and select declared executable. No game boot occurs in this completion path.
generic.local_changes_or_transform: Only the declarative operations/launch contract in the recipe; see complete recipe payload in catalog-review.json. This is not a binary-origin audit.

n64_portable.behavior: Hash-check supported original ROM and fixed official runtime kit; copy media into runtime-specific portable location; set marker/arguments/environment. No reconstruction of missing gameplay in this C# path.

xbox_portable.behavior: Fixed release kit plus title-specific original Xbox media validation/import. ReBlue and Unleashed dispatch to their own Resume methods; other branches import data or invoke bundled official extraction/cache commands.
xbox_portable.local_changes_or_transform: Original title updates imported for NG2/Downpour/PGR4. Unleashed applies original TU through helper. ReBlue merges original language configuration. Dead Rising invokes upstream shader-cache/overlay generation. No blanket copy-only classification.

direct_gamecube.behavior: Verify exact kit manifest, original disc region/revision/size and SHA-1; copy original ISO/GCM unchanged; pass original disc argument/environment to official runtime.

direct_media.behavior: Verify kit/media hash and size; copy original media (optional SNES copier header removed). God Hand additionally invokes official GHR.exe --prepare --iso and checks extracted boot ELF hash.
direct_media.local_changes_or_transform: Media-header normalization for supported SNES inputs; God Hand official preparation. No C# overwrite of runtime game code.

torch_staged.behavior: ROM import followed by fixed Torch asset-generation CLI; validate archive metadata/output; publish original runtime kit plus generated resources.
torch_staged.local_changes_or_transform: Helper/source-origin verification is a separate NativeExtractors audit. Reading this caller does not establish that every helper is unmodified.

soh.behavior: Hash-check original ROM and official kit, run fixed Torch extraction for O2R resources, verify output.
soh.local_changes_or_transform: Deletes temporary Torch hash cache; helper provenance reviewed separately.

2ship.behavior: Validate original ROM, run fixed ZAPD resource extraction, validate generated O2R.
2ship.local_changes_or_transform: Official extractor arguments; no game source rewrite in caller.

starship.behavior: Validate fixed ROM editions and official kit; call Torch for resource extraction and validate output.

spaghetti.behavior: Validate original MK64 ROM and official kit; call fixed Torch resource generation and validate output.

lighthouse.behavior: Validate original Banjo ROM and official kit; call fixed Torch resource generation and validate output.

adam.behavior: Use already imported verified original ROM; stage fixed runtime dependencies and portable launch.
adam.local_changes_or_transform: No game source generation in this method.

bluewake.behavior: Validate original GZLE01 disc and official runtime kit; helper extracts original DOL/REL/resources and validates them.

wwhd.behavior: Invoke bundled official setup.py for original Wii U data; require real Windows installation and reject placeholder_code.
wwhd.local_changes_or_transform: Flags --no-decomp --code-mods 0 --skip-shader-prebuild select upstream options; not proof of game boot.

nectar.behavior: Validate Pikmin/Pikmin2 original discs, call fixed native image extractor, verify resulting files and selection.
nectar.local_changes_or_transform: Custom helper boundary, sources outside Git investigated separately.

radz.behavior: Use fixed official launcher/tool bundle and original ROM; compile pinned snesrev sources with bundled TCC and generate assets.
radz.local_changes_or_transform: Compiler options STBI_NO_SIMD=1 and SYSTEM_VOLUME_MIXER_AVAILABLE=0 disable image SIMD and OS volume mixer integration. No source file overwrite found in caller.

phase.behavior: Validate EarthBound/Mother2 ROM, normalize optional copier header, invoke official importer, verify required generated resources.
phase.local_changes_or_transform: Header normalization is media preparation, not new gameplay.

picori.behavior: Validate original GBA ROM, prepare Picori runtime and invoke extraction CLI; verify cache/pak/sound resources. AutoTMC route downloads the same Picori runtime.
picori.local_changes_or_transform: Normalizes generated rom_mtime stamp to zero. AutoTMC and Picori are two catalog IDs for this shared engine path.

goldensun.behavior: Call official gsr_builder.exe --rom --work to generate game library from original ROM; require completion marker and fixed build/engine/library identity.
goldensun.local_changes_or_transform: Official source-generation boundary; not merely copying a launcher, not AllFix-authored gameplay.

opengoal.behavior: Call official extractor.exe with --extract --validate --decompile --compile; validate serial/build-info and KERNEL.CGO/GAME.CGO.
opengoal.local_changes_or_transform: Upstream decompilation/compilation workflow; no AllFix source patch in caller.

shadowrome.behavior: Validate original PS2 ISO and extract required original executable/data; select official runtime and retain original image reference.
shadowrome.local_changes_or_transform: No gameplay implementation in C# handler.

symphony.behavior: Validate original PSX disc tracks, extract original resources and convert original CD audio.
symphony.local_changes_or_transform: Data/media conversion; no runtime source write.

wipeoutphantom.behavior: Validate nine original track hashes; import 517 named resources, XA sector data and convert CDDA to WAV.
wipeoutphantom.local_changes_or_transform: Custom data extractor; preserves official runtime kit. Not new levels/game logic.

redriver.behavior: Validate two matching original discs; call bundled jpsxdec.jar to convert original videos/audio; verify RIFF and file plan; launch official runtime with original disc.
redriver.local_changes_or_transform: Media conversion only in handler; original discs retained as launch inputs.

severed.behavior: Validate original disc set and bundled Java JARs; run official legend.game.unpacker.Unpacker through generated Java launcher.
severed.local_changes_or_transform: Writes temporary AllFixSeveredUnpack Java adapter calling official Unpacker; does not modify JAR game sources.

silenthill.behavior: Validate supported original BIN and stage media/launch configuration for fixed official runtime.
silenthill.local_changes_or_transform: No game source write in handler.

vandal.behavior: Validate supported original BIN and stage media for fixed official runtime.
vandal.local_changes_or_transform: No game source write in handler.

bloodyroar.behavior: Validate original BIN, write CUE description, invoke official --headless --verify-disc.
bloodyroar.local_changes_or_transform: CUE launch descriptor; verification command is not gameplay homologation.

knowyourrole.behavior: Validate original PSX BIN, invoke pinned official CLI generator with --cue --out; verify generated managed assemblies.
knowyourrole.local_changes_or_transform: Bundled custom-published CLI/extractor boundary; build script uses official source. No game source edit observed in caller.

kingsfield.behavior: Validate original Japanese PSX disc; invoke fixed extraction helper and verify Japanese data.
kingsfield.local_changes_or_transform: Helper adapter build includes conditional NOMINMAX edit in translation_ppf.cpp and optional empty English translation include. Do not classify as entirely unmodified.

trx.behavior: Validate original PC level formats and required files; map original level/media into TRX or OpenLara runtime layout.
trx.local_changes_or_transform: Layout/copy and game-selection marker. OpenLara uses its own import-plan/launch helper.

rsdk.behavior: Replace recipe contract locally with original Data.rsdk import plus index/GameConfig edition validation; generic ApplyRecipe completes.
rsdk.local_changes_or_transform: Reads/decrypts a bounded GameConfig prefix for validation; original Data.rsdk copied unchanged.

teamforever.behavior: Unpack fixed official ModOnly packages, import validated Data.rsdk from RSDK/APK; launch actual official Windows game executable.
teamforever.local_changes_or_transform: Three catalog IDs share two actual engines. Combined catalog ID is deprecated but still counted.

sonicadventure.behavior: Extract fixed NSIS kit offline; validate original Dreamcast data and construct expected RAM/data through official bootstrap delta.
sonicadventure.local_changes_or_transform: BuildSonicRam applies bundled upstream bootstrap.xor.z; not a copy-only path. Output hashes checked.

mml.behavior: Extract fixed PyInstaller package offline, validate original PC EXE edition and apply verified upstream binary patch plan to staging copy.
mml.local_changes_or_transform: 121 ranges/247 bytes plus 512-byte tail per US/JP EXE. Full plan independently equals upstream literal manifest at 09b8dd3; see verify_mml_parity.py.

marathon.behavior: Validate fixed official runtime kit and import original Xbox media against upstream expected file manifest.
marathon.local_changes_or_transform: Original content imported, no runtime rewrite in handler.

edgeoftime.behavior: Validate original ISO plus Title Update STFS; copy official XEXP/DLLP patches and game data for official runtime.
edgeoftime.local_changes_or_transform: Imports official update data; does not synthesize missing game code.

gt4.behavior: Validate original PS2 ISO/edition, call fixed helper to extract ELF/CORE and verify receipt; launch fixed official game runtime.
gt4.local_changes_or_transform: Normalizes receipt disc path; forces GT4_RENDERER=hw and GT4_HW_CORE=2 and shader-cache location. Helper provenance separate.

linkedps4.behavior: Fetch fixed hash-pinned official prepare/link/content/patch/ISA scripts; generate linked modules and patch metadata from original PS4 dump.
linkedps4.local_changes_or_transform: Runs official tlg_patches.py/infamous_patches.py and isa_rewrite.py --red-zone. This modifies derived code by upstream procedure, not missing gameplay authored by AllFix.

pt.behavior: Validate original PS4 dump and fixed runtime, import original data and invoke native preparation tools.
pt.local_changes_or_transform: See handler body/required output checks; not a new Windows port authored in this method.

findings.finding: Completion executes callback, validates output launch format (or Java contract), reads manifest and publishes with Verified=true/Completed. It does not run gameplay or establish upstream completeness.

Unknown/ineligible kit is rejected. Last fallback saves media selection in existing partial state; it does not change status to Completed. Recognized paths can Complete after structural prep without first boot.

ForzaInnoProfile has a complete resume branch into BuildForzaGame through StageForzaCompilerInputs, but is missing from CanCompletePreparation. AutomationRank therefore reports 1 for that recipe; this is a static classification mismatch, not a proven UI block.

Some upstream launchers generate/compile code from original media. AllFix invokes their fixed CLI functions. That is distinct from authoring missing gameplay; also distinct from merely copying a launcher.
These paths apply configuration changes, upstream binary deltas or official generation scripts. They cannot be described collectively as absolutely unmodified.

This handler review establishes call/dataflow and guards. Fixed hashes do not alone establish helper source parity. Companion native-extractor audit covers available sources and remaining provenance gaps.
